currentTransformation.title: Make the complete climb look, feel and play markedly better
currentTransformation.state: BUILDING PLAYABLE ART SLICE — QUALITY NOT EVALUATED
currentTransformation.promise: An immediately recognizable leap in fully realized 3D cast, environments, grounded movement, meaningful autonomous action and immersive gameplay.
currentTransformation.nextDecision: Inspect real matched desktop/portrait first-ascent GPU frames and continuous gameplay after integration of G52 vista plus Ruins sanctuary. Only keep the visual slice if it meaningfully improves the whole in-game shot without masking route/hero; then transform complete character grip/pull/mantle, combat and pacing before matched 60s baseline/candidate footage and blind reviewer voting.
currentTransformation.rejectedMicroMilestones: A green CI run, an isolated pose fix, a prettier screenshot or an extra UI icon never counts as a Gauntlet win.
